paite: TOUPA, suan tengteng tan a ka tenna uh nangmah na hi a,
heading: Pathian Leh Mihing Tanchin / BU LINA / (Sam 90-106) / Pathian Mi, Mosi Thumna

paite: Tangte pian ma a, leitung leh khovel na bawlkhiak ma in leng; tangtawn a kipan tangtawn Pathian, nangmah na hi.
Nang mihingte manthatna ah na kiksak a; mihing tate aw, kikta un, na chi zel hi.
Nang seh in kum sangkhat zan mangta bang phet ahi a, zanven khat sung bang phet ahi.
Amaute tui lian bang in na taimang a; khang khat ihmu bang phet ahi ua, zingsang a loupa dawnkhia bang ahi uhi.
Zingsang in ahong pou in ahong dawnkhia a; nitaklam in phuk in a-om a, avuai hi.
Na hehna a hihman in ka om ua, na thangpaihna a hihmangbat a leng ka om ziak un.
Ka thulimlouhnate uh na ma ah na koih a, ka khelhna gukte uh na mel vak ah na koihta hi.
Ka damsung ni tengteng uh na hehna ah amang zel a; ka damsung kumte uh tangthu bang in ka tawpsak uhi.
Ka damsung kumte uh kum sawmsagih ahi a, hatna ziak in kum sawmgiat leng ahi thei hi; himahleh asawtna zaw sepgimna leh lungngaihna lel ahi a; amang pah a, kou leng ka lengmang zel uhi.
Kua'n ahia na hehna thilhihtheihdan thei a, nangmah kihtakdan ding a na hehna thei lou?
Ka damsung nite uh simdan hon hilh in, huchi a pilna lungtang ka neihloh hialna ding un.
TOUPA aw, hong kik nawn in; bang tan ahia na heh ding? Na sikhate tungthu ah na lungsim kiheisak in.
Aw, zingsang in na zahngaihna in hon taisak in; ka damsung tengteng ua ka nuam ua ka kipahtheihna ding un.
Nang na hon hihgim ni leh, thil hoih lou ka tuah kum sung hute bang un hon kipaksak in.
Nna nasep na sikhate kiang ah kithei henla, na thupina atate kiang uah kithei hen.
TOUPA ka Pathian uh kilawmna ka tung uah om hen, ka khut nasep uh ka tung uah leng hihkip in; ahi, ka khut nasep uh hihkip in.
